description: This file is a PHP class that defines the SubscriptionPlan model in the OpenCart admin system. It contains methods for creating, reading, updating, deleting, copying, and listing subscription plan records and their descriptions in the database. It also manages the status of subscription plans.

classes.name: SubscriptionPlan
classes.description: Model class for managing subscription plans within the OpenCart admin system. Provides CRUD operations, description management, and status updates for subscription plans stored in the database.

methods.name: addSubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Creates a new subscription plan record in the database with provided data, including descriptions for different languages. Returns the new subscription plan's ID.

methods.name: editSubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Updates an existing subscription plan record identified by ID with new data, including handling descriptions.

methods.name: copySubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Duplicates an existing subscription plan by copying its data and descriptions to create a new record.

methods.name: deleteSubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Deletes a subscription plan record from the database, along with its descriptions and associated product subscriptions.

methods.name: getSubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Retrieves a subscription plan record with its description for the current language.

methods.name: getSubscriptionPlans
methods.description: Retrieves a list of subscription plans with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Changes the status (active/inactive) of a specified subscription plan.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionPlans
methods.description: Returns the total count of subscription plan records, optionally filtered by name or language.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a subscription plan in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a specific subscription plan.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Removes all subscription plan descriptions in a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a given subscription plan.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches all subscription plan descriptions in a specific language.
